definitions.gloss: exploded view; breakdown diagram showing the component parts of a product
definitions.explanation: A technical illustration that shows the individual parts of a product separated out along the lines they fit together, so that the viewer can see how everything is assembled. Used in manuals, parts catalogs, repair guides, and engineering documentation.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}の{分解図|ぶんかいず}。
examples.english: An exploded view of the machine.

examples.japanese: {取扱説明書|とりあつかいせつめいしょ}に{分解図|ぶんかいず}が{載|の}っている。
examples.english: The instruction manual has an exploded view.

examples.japanese: {修理|しゅうり}をする{前|まえ}に{分解図|ぶんかいず}をよく{見|み}て{部品|ぶひん}の{位置|いち}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Before doing the repair, check the exploded view carefully to confirm where each part goes.

examples.japanese: この{分解図|ぶんかいず}を{見|み}れば、{各|かく}パーツがどのように{組|く}み{立|た}てられているかが{一目|ひとめ}でわかる。
examples.english: Looking at this exploded view, you can see at a glance how each part is assembled.

notes:
Composed of {分解|ぶんかい} (disassembly, breakdown) and {図|ず} (figure, diagram).

USAGE:
{分解図|ぶんかいず} is a technical term that appears in instruction manuals, repair documentation, patent drawings, and parts-ordering catalogs. It refers specifically to a diagram where parts are drawn pulled apart along axes so their assembly relationships are visible — the English concept of an "exploded view."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分解図|ぶんかいず}を{見|み}る: to look at the exploded view
- {分解図|ぶんかいず}を{描|か}く: to draw an exploded view
- {部品|ぶひん}の{分解図|ぶんかいず}: exploded view of parts
- {詳細|しょうさい}な{分解図|ぶんかいず}: detailed exploded view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組立図|くみたてず}: assembly diagram — shows the parts together and how to build them up, roughly the reverse concept
- {構造図|こうぞうず}: structural diagram — a more general term for any diagram showing internal structure
- {配線図|はいせんず}: wiring diagram — specific to electrical connections
- {設計図|せっけいず}: design drawing, blueprint — the broader design documentation a {分解図|ぶんかいず} may be part of
